# basalt-ui v2.0.5
# Opinionated framework for Mantine-based React apps — theme, app shell, TanStack Charts, toolchain presets
#
# Entry points: use the exact import specifier below; do not guess.
# basalt-ui            BasaltProvider, createBasaltRouter, BasaltShell, defineNav, PageBar, Section
# basalt-ui/tokens     VX, defineSeries, groupTokens, buildPaletteCss
# basalt-ui/charts     CartesianChart, Lines, Bars, ChartCard
# basalt-ui/controls   FilterSet, ViewTabs, RangeFilter, SelectFilter
# basalt-ui/state      createSearchStore, createPersistedState
# basalt-ui/vite       basaltViteConfig, basaltAppPlugin
# Required peers (install for `.`): react, react-dom, @mantine/{core,hooks,modals,notifications,spotlight},
# @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/react-query and the three @fontsource-variable faces.
# A subpath's `Install:` line is its required peers; `OptionalPeers:` are import()-only, install on use.

Package: basalt-ui
Version: 2.0.5

## basalt-ui
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui'
Description: Wiring (`BasaltProvider`, `createBasaltTheme`, `createBasaltRouter`, `unwrap`), shell + nav (`BasaltShell`, `PageBar`, `PageAside`, `PageTitle`, `ThemeToggle`, `defineNav`/`navGroup`/`navTarget`/`flattenNav`, `useBasaltNav`, `useSizeClass`, `useCoarsePointer`), dashboard (`Section`, `WidgetHeader`, `StatCard`, `StatGroup`, `DeltaBadge`, `EmptyState`, `SettingsSection`/`SettingsRow`/`DangerZone`). Reaches no subpath-required peer.
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-mantine
OptionalPeers: remark-gfm@^4.0.1, rehype-sanitize@^6.0.0, remend@1.4.0, shiki@^4.5.0, beautiful-mermaid@^1.1.0, @tanstack/react-router-devtools@^1.166.13

## basalt-ui/charts
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/charts'
Description: CartesianChart (the TanStack Charts rung), the Lines and Bars kinds, ChartCard and the shared chartCursor (Mantine-free; @tanstack/charts + d3-scale peers)
Layer: headless
Rule: basalt-charts
Install: bun add @tanstack/charts@1.1.0 d3-scale@4.0.2

## basalt-ui/tokens
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/tokens'
Description: VX token refs, buildPaletteCss, defineSeries, seriesTokens, groupTokens, alpha (Mantine-free)
Layer: headless
Rule: basalt-tokens

## basalt-ui/vite
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/vite'
Description: basaltViteConfig(opts) — Vite preset for basalt-ui consumer apps; basaltAppPlugin(opts) — PWA head, manifest, and icon metadata derived from the token palette
Layer: build-tooling
Install: bun add 'vite@^7 || ^8'
OptionalPeers: vite-plugin-pwa@^1.3.0

## basalt-ui/format
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/format'
Description: integer/money/percent/durationClock/relativeTime/weekday/km/kcal — Intl-backed, Mantine-free, React-free formatting; the chart layer formats through the same implementation
Layer: headless
Signature: integer(value: number, { locale? }) => string
Signature: money(value: number, { currency: string, compact?, digits?, locale? }) => string
Signature: percent(value: number, { input?: 'ratio' | 'percent', digits?, locale? }) => string
Signature: km(meters: number, { digits? }) => string
Signature: kcal(value: number, { digits? }) => string
Signature: durationClock(seconds: number) => string
Signature: relativeTime(value: number | Date | string, { now?, locale? }) => string
Signature: weekday(value: Date | number | string, { format?: 'short' | 'long' | 'narrow', locale? }) => string

## basalt-ui/forms
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/forms'
Description: Mantine form layer: useBasaltForm + inputProps/fieldKey (two calls — a spread `key` is a React 19 warning), on @mantine/form
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-batteries
Install: bun add @mantine/form@^9.7.0

## basalt-ui/commands
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/commands'
Description: defineCommands (typed command bus), defineOverlays/overlays, setColorScheme, toggleSidebar, ShortcutsHelp, defineNotifications/emit/NotificationBell (folded in from ./notifications); BasaltProvider mounts Spotlight, Modals and Notifications
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-batteries
Install: bun add @tanstack/react-hotkeys@0.13.0

## basalt-ui/table
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/table'
Description: BasaltDataTable and createColumnHelper: a data table over TanStack Table v9, rendered with Mantine (renamed from ./data/table)
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-batteries
Install: bun add @tanstack/react-table@9.2.8

## basalt-ui/agent
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/agent'
Description: Streaming-chat surface: aiSdkTransport, useAgentThreadRuns, parseAgentPart, the open part-registry types, the consumer-owned thread contracts (AgentThread/ThreadsStore/ChatMessage), and the Mantine chat UI folded in from ./agent-chat (ThreadFeed, ThreadFeedRow, Composer, ToolChip). motion is subpath-required: the chat UI imports it eagerly
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-batteries
Install: bun add ai@^7.0.137 @ai-sdk/provider@^4.0.26 motion@14.1.0
OptionalPeers: use-stick-to-bottom@^1.1.6, @tanstack/react-virtual@>=3.14.0 <4

## basalt-ui/content
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/content'
Description: Prose (article/chat typography), Callout, TableOfContents, Markdown (react-markdown + remark-gfm, optional peers; `streaming` is a rendering mode ONLY — `contentTrust` is the independent security input, and any surface rendering agent/model output must pin `contentTrust="untrusted"`, the sole input to the image-origin allowlist; `fenceRenderers` extends fenced-block rendering — settledOnly/FenceRenderer/FenceRenderers; `sanitizeSchema` is an additions-only SanitizeSchemaExtension merged over the default via mergeSanitizeSchema; shiki code blocks, beautiful-mermaid diagrams and the remend streaming repair load lazily from optional peers), ArticleLayout (docs-page frame), GuideLink (contextual-help link) — the content/prose surface
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-batteries
Install: bun add react-markdown@^10.1.0
OptionalPeers: shiki@^4.5.0, @shikijs/langs@^4.5.0, @shikijs/themes@^4.5.0, beautiful-mermaid@^1.1.0, remark-gfm@^4.0.1, rehype-sanitize@^6.0.0, remend@1.4.0

## basalt-ui/controls
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/controls'
Description: The control tier (docs/CONTROLS-SPEC.md §3): FilterSet (nowrap row + measured +N fold + the mobile Filters (n) sheet), RangeFilter/CompareFilter/SelectFilter/MultiSelectFilter/NumberFilter/SearchFilter/ToggleFilter (each bound to a FieldHandle — no value/onChange/size, law C2/C5; NumberFilter is the field.number lane, a radio list over `options` or a stepper without), ViewTabs, the action/sync family (ActionGroup, OverflowMenu, SyncButton, BarAction/GlobalAction), and the form layout FormSection/FormRow/FormGroup/FormActions (moved here from ./forms in 1.36.0 — FormRow is law C1’s form row and needs no @mantine/form). THREE surfaces, picked by the home and never by a prop (useFilterSurface): pill in a PageBar row, sheet in the mobile Filters (n) drawer, panel in a PageAside body — where every control renders an inspector/facet ROW instead of a chip (docs/ASIDE-SPEC.md §3). PanelRow is that row primitive (label above, hint, mono readout, an `end` control on the label line) and SliderControl is the one bound control with no pill form at all; the counts/max props on MultiSelectFilter render the Foundry facet list there. Every control owns its own desktop/mobile swap in CSS (C9) and renders size="ctl" internally. Resolves and renders with NO @mantine/dates installed — the custom date picker is injected through RangeFilter.customPicker from ./controls-dates.
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-controls

## basalt-ui/controls-dates
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/controls-dates'
Description: DateRangePicker — the @mantine/dates implementation of RangeFilter's customPicker seam. Its own subpath because @mantine/dates is an optional peer and basaltViteConfig pre-bundles the whole @mantine scope, so a consumer without the peer (linewatch) must never resolve it: nothing under src/controls may import it, statically or lazily (docs/CONTROLS-SPEC.md §3).
Layer: mantine-coupled
Rule: basalt-controls
Install: bun add @mantine/dates@^9.7.0 dayjs@^1.11.0

## basalt-ui/state
Import: import { ... } from 'basalt-ui/state'
Description: field.enum/multi/range/number/boolean/string (the store field vocabulary), createSearchStore (typed URL > localStorage > fallback store), createLocalStore (the router-free store), createPersistedState (versioned localStorage)
Layer: headless
Rule: basalt-state

## basalt-ui/styles.css
Asset: basalt-ui/styles.css
Description: Mandatory CSS import (after the Mantine styles.layer.css bundles) — @layer basalt base styles, iOS input safety net, font stack
Layer: non-js-asset

## basalt-ui/configs/*
Asset: basalt-ui/configs/*
Description: Raw toolchain presets for consumer extends: oxlint.json (or the guards-only oxlint-basalt.json), oxfmt.json, tsconfig.*.json, lefthook.yml, check.yml
Layer: non-js-asset
